_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 2: font expander, icon builders, text box (06C-4CA). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8000`
regions.description: `JMP $80BB`: load font set 0 (the records at `$80EC`). Callers: bank 0 `$8312` (the title) and `$8918` (the ending's credits).

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8003`
regions.description: `JMP $81B2`: upload item icon A to CHR. Callers: bank 3 `$8226`, bank 5 `$854A` and `$870D`.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8006`
regions.description: `JMP $8212`: build key icon A in CHR. Callers: bank 5 `$856E` and `$8F4C`, bank 7 `$ED6E`, `$ED8E` and `$F566`.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8009`
regions.description: `JMP $82C0`: the text box / dialogue machine. Callers: bank 6 `$9A0E` (the message object, type `$34`) and bank 5 `$9F98` (the gate banner).

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$800C`
regions.description: `JMP $8153`: load font set 1 (eight glyphs into tiles `$08-$0F`). Caller: bank 5 `$875D` (the status screen's close).

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$800F`
regions.description: `JMP $84CB`: the item objects (types `$31`-`$33`). Caller: bank 6 `$99F4`.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8012`
regions.description: `JMP $8158`: load font set 2 (the password screen's glyphs). Caller: bank 3 `$82DC`.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8015`
regions.description: `JMP $86BC`: the pick-up effects. Caller: bank 3 `$8107` (the reward screen).

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8018`
regions.description: `JMP $8820`: CHIP MAX from the chip level. Caller: bank 0 `$8152` (the game's start).

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$801B`
regions.description: `JMP $8836`: the scene after corridor 21 (planet, ship and explosions). Caller: bank 7 `$ECD9`.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$801E`
regions.description: `JMP $8998`: the status screen's blinking position marker. Callers: bank 5 `$868A` and `$89C8`.

regions.name: BANK 2 JUMP TABLE: slot `$8021`
regions.description: `JMP $8A69`: the ending. Caller: bank 7 `$F6AF` (the final score screen).

regions.name: FONT EXPANDER (bank 2 `$806C`): reserve and address
regions.description: `LDA #$13 / JSR $C04B / JSR $C03C`: 19 bytes of the PPU queue; Y/A = the offset. **One glyph a call, `$15` times.**

regions.name: FONT EXPANDER (bank 2 `$806C`): the queue item's header
regions.description: `$12` := X (saved); an item of count `$10` (16 bytes, increment 1) at the PPU address `$19:$18`.

regions.name: FONT EXPANDER (bank 2 `$806C`): the 7 rows
regions.description: For Y = 0..7: the byte `($1A),Y` goes to the item (rows of the LOW bit plane) and the same position `+8` (the HIGH plane) is zeroed. It reads eight bytes, one more than a glyph has.

regions.name: FONT EXPANDER (bank 2 `$806C`): row 7 blank
regions.description: The eighth source byte is overwritten with 0 (`$0102,X` after the loop): **a glyph is seven bytes in rows 0-6, row 7 and the whole high plane are zero.**

regions.name: FONT EXPANDER (bank 2 `$806C`): next glyph
regions.description: The PPU address `$19:$18` += `$10` (the next tile), the source `$1B:$1A` += 7; commit (`$C03F`); `DEC $15` and again.

regions.name: FONT RECORD LOADER (`$80BB`, `$80C5`, `$8153`, `$8158`): a whole set (`$80BB`)
regions.description: Y := 0 (set 0; sets 1 and 2 enter at `$80BD` with Y = `$1F` / `$48`): `JSR $80C5` until it returns `$FF`.

regions.name: FONT RECORD LOADER (`$80BB`, `$80C5`, `$8153`, `$8158`): one record (`$80C5`)
regions.description: `$80EC,Y` is the count (`$FF` ends); the record is [count][dest lo][dest hi][src lo][src hi]: `$15` := count, `$19:$18` := dest (PPU), `$1B:$1A` := src.

regions.name: FONT RECORD LOADER (`$80BB`, `$80C5`, `$8153`, `$8158`): run it
regions.description: Y + 5 is saved, `JSR $806C` expands the record's glyphs, Y comes back pointing at the next record (A = the next count, `$FF` at the end of the set). Returns `$FF` in A at the end.

regions.name: FONT RECORD LOADER (`$80BB`, `$80C5`, `$8153`, `$8158`): set 1 (`$8153`)
regions.description: `LDY #$1F / JMP $80BD`: records from `$810B`: eight glyphs into sprite tiles `$08-$0F` (a e f i o t and two more, the dialogue's common letters).

regions.name: FONT RECORD LOADER (`$80BB`, `$80C5`, `$8153`, `$8158`): set 2 (`$8158`)
regions.description: `LDY #$48 / JMP $80BD`: records from `$8134`: the password screen's lowercase letters, `!` `?`, the umlaut dots and the slashed zero.

regions.name: ONE GLYPH TO CHR (`$815D`): queue the seven bytes of one glyph
regions.description: A = an ASCII code `$30-$7A`, `$19:$18` = the CHR address of the tile. An item of 7 bytes (rows 0-6 of the low plane only; the high plane and row 7 are left as they were).

regions.name: ONE GLYPH TO CHR (`$815D`): glyph address
regions.description: (A - `$30`) x 7 + `$8BF8` into `$11:$10` (x 3, x 2 + 1 = x 7): **the font table is indexed by ASCII - `$30` for the whole range `$30-$7A`** (45 glyphs, then the 31 of `$8D33`).

regions.name: ONE GLYPH TO CHR (`$815D`): copy and commit
regions.description: The seven bytes into the item; `LDX $12 / JMP $C03F`.

regions.name: ICON UPLOADER (`$81B2`): icon address
regions.description: A = the icon number n: `$8E0C + 64 n` into `$17:$16` (64 bytes = four 2bpp tiles).

regions.name: ICON UPLOADER (`$81B2`): two items
regions.description: The CHR address is in `$19:$18` (the caller). **Two queue items of 32 bytes (two tiles each)**: reserve, header `$20`, copy 32 bytes from `($16),Y`; after the first 32 the PPU address += `$20` and the second item starts; after 64 the last is committed.

regions.name: KEY ICON BUILDER (`$8212`): source
regions.description: A = key number k: `$92AC + 32 k` into `$17:$16` (the key's low plane: 32 bytes, 4 tiles x 8).

regions.name: KEY ICON BUILDER (`$8212`): two items of two tiles
regions.description: Each tile's 16 bytes are built as **8 bytes from the key's own table followed by 8 bytes of the SHARED high plane `$928C` (32 bytes, the same for every key)**: in an item of 32 bytes tile 0 = `($16),Y` + `$928C,Y`, tile 1 = `($16),Y+8` + `$9294,Y`; the second item (Y from `$10`) is tiles 2 and 3. The PPU address += `$20` between the items; the caller sets it (`$1000` in a room with a key door, `$15C0` for the key reward).

regions.name: FONT EXPANDER (bank 2 `$806C`): tile number to CHR address (`$827F`)
Text box column by screen type
regions.description: `0D 0D 08 0C 0C 0D 0D 0C` for `$51` = 1..8 (read at `$8291+Y`, the base is the `RTS` of `$827F`).

regions.name: Text box row by screen type
regions.description: `0B 09 0B 04 04 09 09 04`: the first text row is one above this.

regions.name: Text box width by screen type
Text box height by screen type
The waiting arrow's x by screen type
regions.description: `A0 B0 7C 00 00 A0 A0` for 1..7; types 4 and 5 never show it.

regions.name: The waiting arrow's y by screen type
regions.description: `7C 68 7C 00 00 68 68` for 1..7 (type 8, the gate banner, would read `$82C0`, the next code byte, and never waits).

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): state, set-up
regions.description: **`$0788` is the state.** Bit 7 set goes to `$8375` (the typing states). State 0 (the first frame; the creator left the message number in `$0788`, the bank 6 handler `$99F8` moved it to `$0620`): `$0638` := 0, and from the tables by the screen type `$51`: `$0680` := the box's column (`$8291+$51`), `$0668` := its row (`$8299+$51`).

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): state < `$70`
regions.description: `$70` or more goes to `$8328`; under `$10` the box is made; else the tile clearing.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): state < `$10`: clear the box area
regions.description: Reserve `$4C` bytes (`$C039`: carry set = no room, try next frame), `JSR $83BE` (below) and `$0788` := `$10`.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): states `$10-$2F`: blank the 32 dynamic tiles
regions.description: Tile = state + `$50` (so `$60-$7F`): CHR address (`$827F`), source `$8D3D` (**eight zero bytes = a blank glyph**), one glyph by the font expander. This runs in a loop while the queue has room (`$C039`, 19 bytes) - RUN: states `$10-$2C` in 8 frames, four tiles a frame - until the state reaches `$30`, when it jumps to `$70`.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): states `$70-$78`: the font
regions.description: n = state - `$70`: Y := 5n + `$1F` and **one record of font set 1 a frame** through `$80C5` (the common letters, tiles `$08-$0F`). When it returns `$FF` the set is done: `$0788` := `$80` and `JSR $C006` (`05 0B 80` = bank 5 `$800C`: select the message, pointer from `$0620`); RUN: states `$70-$78` in nine frames.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): reset the dynamic tile counter
regions.description: `$0650` := `$60`: the next free tile of the 32.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): end of the message (state `$83`)
regions.description: A screen type other than 3 just stays (RTS): the text stays on show until the object is removed. **Type 3 (a message screen): Select HELD (`$F7` bit 5) and a NEW A or B (`$F5` bits 7-6) restart the box with the NEXT message** - `$0500` := `$34` (bit 7 off, so the bank 6 handler reads the message number again), `$0620` += 1, wrapping from 21 to 0, stored in `$0788`. RUN: Select + A at the end of message 5 in type 3 showed message 6; in type 2 nothing. Whether this is reachable in play (a new Select press first opens the status screen, `$F493`) was not established: a LEAD, perhaps a leftover message viewer.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): the typing states
regions.description: `$80` goes to `$83F3` (fetch the next character), `$83` to the end, `$81` waits for a button, anything else (`$82`) clears the page.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): state `$81`: end of a screenful
regions.description: A NEW B (`$F5` / `$F6` bit 6) takes the state to `$82`. Otherwise **the arrow blinks: sprite `$37` (tile base `$0B`) at x `$82B1+$51`, y `$82B8+$51`, drawn when `$41` bit 4 is clear.** RUN: A alone did nothing, B continued.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): B pressed
TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): state `$82`: clear the page and go on
regions.description: Reserve `$50`, clear the box (`$83BE`), `$0788` := `$80`, and `JMP $8348` resets the dynamic tile counter.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): clear the text area (`$83BE`)
regions.description: The cursor (`$0608` column, `$05F0` row) := the box's origin (`$0680`, `$0668`).

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): clear: where
regions.description: `$19:$18` := the PPU address of the cursor (`$84B1`), one row up (`$84A5`).

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): clear: the loop
regions.description: Fill tile `$14` := `$20` (blank), width `$15` := `$82A1+$51`, height `$17` := `$82A9+$51` rows: a run of blanks (`$C036`) per row, the address += `$20`. **This box is only a blank area - no frame is drawn.**

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): fetch a character (`$83F3`)
regions.description: `JSR $C006` with `05 0E 80`: bank 5 `$800F` (the dialogue fetch, one character a call; `$15` = the current character).

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): 0: the end
regions.description: A character 0 sets the state `$83`.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): 1: a screenful
regions.description: Character 1 sets the state `$81`.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): `$0D`: a new line
regions.description: The column `$0608` := the box's column, the row `$05F0` += 1 and on to the next character in the same frame.

regions.name: Characters with a fixed tile
Their tiles
regions.description: `08 09 0C 0D 0E 0F`: font set 1.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): which tile? (`$8429`)
regions.description: The six characters `a e f i o t` (table `$841D`) take the fixed tiles `$08 $09 $0C $0D $0E $0F` of font set 1. Otherwise: **`$5C` and above (lowercase and the rest of the font) and `$3A-$3F` (the punctuation) get a NEW tile each time**; `$40-$5B` (`@`, A-Z and `[`... the full stop is `$5B`), `$30-$39` (digits), space and everything else are drawn directly as their own tile.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): a direct character
regions.description: Reserve 4 bytes (`$C039`); no room: `DEC $0638,X` (the fetch is taken back) and return, to try again next frame. Otherwise queue the tile (`$8482`), the column += 1 and fetch the next character in the same frame.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): after the tile
TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): a dynamic character
regions.description: Reserve 14 bytes; **tile `$0650` (from `$60`) gets the glyph: CHR address by `$827F`, the glyph by `$815D`**; the tile number is queued at the cursor (`$8482`), `$0650` += 1. RUN: the typed letters come out as tiles `$60, $61, $62 ...` and the CHR bytes at those tiles equal the font's glyphs.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): queue one tile (`$8482`)
regions.description: An item of count 1: PPU address of the cursor (`$84B1`) minus one row (`$84A5`), tile = `$15`.

regions.name: TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): one row up (`$84A5`)
TEXT BOX / DIALOGUE (type `$34`, bank 2 `$82C0`, slot `$8009`; X = the object): cursor to PPU address (`$84B1`)
regions.description: `$2000 + 32 x row + column` from `$05F0` and `$0608` into `$19:$18` (nametable 0 only).
